title: Zana shingen bodice, motsa darts, a gwada shi a cikin bandaki

say: Zana shingen bodice, motsa darts, a gwada shi a cikin bandaki.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don Module 2 na Babban Tailoring da Samfura.
Tare da hanyar kwata, kuna tsara rabin baya da rabi na gaba. Kowanne kwata ne na fadin jiki.

panel.heading: Rabin baya, rabin gaba
items: Kowane guntu kashi ɗaya cikin huɗu ne na jiki
Ƙara kashi ɗaya cikin huɗu na sauƙi ga kowane
Formules suna farawa
Toile yana da kalmar ƙarshe

say: Don haka kowane yanki yana samun kwata na sauƙi. Misali, Kemi tana da tsummoki 96 cm da kugu 78 cm. Tare da 6 cm na sauƙi mai sauƙi da 4 cm a kugu, wato 1.5 cm da 1 cm a kowace kwata.

say: Zana layin baya na tsakiya kuma yi alamar nape kusa da saman. Ƙauna ƙasa da guntun Kemi zuwa tsayin kugu, 39 cm, da murabba'i a fadin ga kugu.

Layin tsatsa: 24 + 1.5 = 25.5 cm
Wuya, kafada 12.5 cm, lanƙwan hannu

say: Alama zurfin hannun hannu. Ƙimar farawa ta gama gari tana raba ƙima da 8, da 10 cm. Don Kemi wato 22 cm. Square fadin. Wannan shine layin bust.

say: A kan layin bust, auna kashi ɗaya cikin huɗu na bust da sauƙi. 24 da 1.5 yana yin 25.5 cm. Zaure ƙasa don jagorar kabu na gefe.

say: Tsawon kwata shine 19.5 da 1, wanda shine 20.5 cm. Layin bust ɗin shine 25.5, don haka dole ne 5 cm ya tafi. Ɗauki 2 cm a gefen kabu, kuma sanya 3 cm a cikin ƙwanƙwasa na baya.
An tsara gaba ta hanya ɗaya, tare da alamar tsatson sa a fili.

say: Gefen gefen gaba shine 20.5 cm. Ya fi tsayi, saboda gaban gaban ya faɗi ƙasa don haye kan ƙirjin.

say: Dart wani yanki ne na masana'anta wanda aka dinka don ya siffata lebur. A gaban bodice, kowane dart yana nunawa a wurin bust.

say: Don haka zaka iya motsa shi a ko'ina a kusa da gefen, kafada, wuyansa ko kugu. Fit ya tsaya iri daya. Kallon kawai yake canzawa.

Misali, Halima dake Kano ta matsar da ledar gefe zuwa kafada, sannan ta mayar da ita gimbiya dinkin rigar rigar leshi ta aso-ebi, mai kyau iri daya.

panel.heading: Abin da toile ya gaya muku
left: Dart points suna nunawa a matsayin kololuwa

say: Ƙara nisa a gefen kabu akan layin bust. Fitar da gibin kuma matsar da shi a cikin ƙwanƙwasa. Rage kaifi mai kaifi da 1 zuwa 2 cm.
Sa'an nan kuma kwafi kowane gyara akan takarda da launi daban-daban, sa'annan ku matsar da shingen da aka gwada akan katin.

panel.heading: Abin da toile ya gaya muku
left: Dart points suna nunawa a matsayin kololuwa
right: Matsar da ƙaramin yanki a cikin dart

say: Don tunawa. Draft a cikin kwata. Bambancin kabu na gefen ya zama baƙar fata. Matsar da darts kewaye da wurin bust. Kuma kada ku yanke ainihin masana'anta har sai bayan gida ya dace.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Quarter na jiki da kwata na sauƙi
Rage kugu: kabu na gefe da dart
Gaban cire gefen gefe = gefen bust dart
Darts suna zagaye da bust point
Gyara takarda bayan kowace bandaki

say: Yanzu zayyana toshewar bodice, yi salo guda uku daga gare ta, kuma ku tsara shingen siket. Sai a dinka bandaki, a saka shi, sannan a gyara takardar.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
